_metadata.description: Profile-keyed conformance packs migrated from scenario-auditor structure/config/ui rules, with default-profile verdict parity and advisory relaxation for unknown profiles.

requirements.title: Default profile reproduces pre-migration verdicts
requirements.description: For the default react-vite/Go profile, the migrated conformance packs (required layout, Makefile shape, ports, runtime storage, UI structure, focus-visible, lifecycle-protect markers) reproduce the pre-migration Structure + scenario-auditor verdicts verbatim — no new findings on already-conformant scenarios.

validation.notes: packs structurepack/configpack/uipack tests accept canonical layouts/Makefiles/ports and reject the same drift the legacy rules rejected.

requirements.title: Unknown profile downgrades profile rules to advisory
requirements.description: When the detected profile is unrecognized (e.g. non-Go backend or non-React UI), profile-specific conformance rules are emitted as advisory rather than blocking, so a valid alternative stack is not falsely failed; recognized profiles keep enforcement severity.

validation.notes: packs_test.go proves an unrecognized profile downgrades to advisory while a recognized profile enforces severity.

requirements.title: Conformance scan excludes the rule-definition tree
requirements.description: When structure-health scans itself, the pack scanner skips its own rule-definition directories so self-scan does not inflate findings from rule source/fixtures.

validation.notes: packs/scan/scan_test.go asserts the rule-definition tree is skipped during the conformance scan.

requirements.title: Expanded language and framework profiles remain contract-aware
requirements.description: When Code Facts exposes reliable parse units for Rust, Python, Vue, or Svelte, structure-health can add first-class profile packs without regressing advisory relaxation for unknown profiles.

validation.notes: Add a profile fixture and conformance pack when the corresponding Code Facts parse-unit contract is available.
